meta.source: OCI_PaaSIaaS_PriceList_20260611.pdf (Oracle PaaS/IaaS Global Price List, 11 Jun 2026)
meta.purpose: Per-unit OCI rates for the services the cloud-bill mapping resolves to, so a source-cloud usage quantity can be re-priced on OCI (e.g. GB of S3 -> same GB on OCI Object Storage). Rates are pay-as-you-go / metered. Keyed by the ociProduct names used in service_mapping.json.
meta.usageBasis: storage = usage quantity treated as GB-month; transfer = GB; count = per-unit/month

OCI Object Storage.note: Set to 0.0255 per request (price list lists 0.0300 for B86080).

OCI Load Balancer.note: Priced per load-balancer-hour. Capacity / LCU usage is included (free) on OCI.

OCI FastConnect.note: Priced per provisioned port-hour by port speed; FastConnect does not meter traffic (ingress/egress data transfer is free).

OCI Web Application Firewall.note: First instance + first 10M requests/month free; $5/instance-month and $0.60 per 1M requests after. Rules / WebACL / bot management bundled. Priced via price_waf_row (basis 'waf' is NOT priced by the generic storage path).

OCI Database Backup.note: Oracle Database Backup Cloud -> Object Storage. Used for PostgreSQL/Aurora-PG/Oracle/Base DB backups. MySQL backups use MySQL Database - Backup Storage (B92483, $0.04/GB-month); SQL Server (self-managed VM) backups use standard Object Storage ($0.0255/GB-month). Priced via price_rds_row (basis 'reference' is NOT priced by the generic storage path).

OCI Logging.note: First 10 GB/month free, then $0.05/GB-month. CloudWatch Logs map here. Priced via price_cloudwatch_logs_row (basis 'logging' is NOT priced by the generic storage path).

OCI DNS.note: $0.85 per 1,000,000 queries; hosted zones and intra-VCN queries free. Route 53 maps here. Priced via price_route53_row (basis 'dns' is NOT priced by the generic storage path).
